note: According to Ahmad's 1965 original description (in English). The original describes both the alate and the soldier and gives measurement tables for both sexes; the worker is not described. Type locality Tung Sa-Lang Luang, Thailand; paratypes from Khao Yai. The original was extracted by OCR from an Internet Archive scan, with occasional glyph errors; the measurements have been checked against the context.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head with many short hairs and scattered long setae; the pronotum as densely hairy as the head. Head nearly circular; fontanelle lens-shaped. Compound eyes projecting, nearly circular, their lower margin about 1/5 of the short diameter of the eye above the lower margin of the head. Ocelli small, broadly oval, the distance to the compound eye equal to their long diameter. Postclypeus short, length less than half its width. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 nearly as long as segment 3. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin nearly straight; posterior margin slightly concave; anterolateral corners broadly rounded.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown, the nasus of the same colour as the head, antennae pale yellowish brown; pronotum reddish brown, slightly paler than the head; abdominal tergites and legs yellowish brown. Posterior half of the head with 2 pairs of setae; apex of the nasus with several short and long hairs, the base with 1—2 setae; pronotum with minute hairs only on the anterior margin, otherwise bare; abdominal tergites almost bare apart from 1—2 setae on the posterior margin. Head pear-shaped; dorsal outline nearly straight; nasus mound faintly visible; nasus short, stout at the base. Apical process of the mandibles short. Antennae 13—14-segmented; in the 13-segmented antenna segment 3 is longer than segments 2 and 4. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum not concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Alate (single morph): head length (to the apex of the clypeus) 1.58; head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.17; head width 1.48; compound eye long diameter 0.41, short diameter 0.36; lower margin of the compound eye 0.07 from the lower margin of the head; ocellus length 0.14, width 0.10; ocellus to compound eye 0.14; pronotum length 0.67, width 1.14. Soldier (12 individuals, holotype/range/mean): head length including the nasus 1.50/1.50—1.79/1.66; head length without the nasus 0.96/0.96—1.11/1.04; head width 0.91/0.91—1.14/1.03; head height 0.72/0.67—0.78/0.72; pronotum length 0.23/0.23—0.26/0.25, width 0.46/0.46—0.49/0.49.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate closest to N. taylori Light & Wilson, differing in the greater distance between the ocellus and the compound eye. Soldier also allied to N. taylori, differing in the shorter mandibular apical process and the stouter nasus; compared with N. garoensis Roonwal & Chhotani from Assam, India, it is smaller and the widest part of the head is more anterior.
